name: Xichang LC-3
tagline: First CZ-3 operational successes — DFH-2 first GTO success, Apstar / Asiasat / Sinosat era
description: Xichang LC-3 hosted the first Long March 3 launch attempt on January 29, 1984 (DFH-2-01), which partially failed on third-stage re-ignition. The first successful Long March 3 flight occurred on April 8, 1984 (DFH-2-02), which placed the DFH-2 'Dong Fang Hong-2' communications satellite into geostationary transfer orbit — China's first GTO success. Both CZ-3 flights were from LC-3. Through the 1990s it supported many Apstar, Asiasat, and Sinosat commercial communications launches. Today it remains in active use alongside LC-2 for Long March 3B operations.
best_known_for: First Chinese GTO success (1984) + comsat workhorse
